publicClaimTransformations: Accountable commitment is bounded, attributable, evidence-aware, contestable, amendable, and repair-aware.
Declaration remains distinct from authorization, ethical validity, and fulfillment.
Commitment authority must be explicit or legitimately inherited rather than ambient or self-created.
Governed amendment and unbinding may revise or retire commitments without silently erasing obligations, consequences, evidence, consent, affected-party recourse, or repair duties.
Covenant is OPTIONAL_METAPHOR_ONLY and never an independent canonical doctrine or source of technical, legal, religious, interpersonal, sacred, or metaphysical authority.
forbiddenClaimsAdded: No independent canonical or literal covenant claim.
No covenant-derived status, personhood, obedience, exclusivity, or privileged interpretation.
No commitment override of consent, privacy, dissent, withdrawal, recourse, or legitimate external authority.
No covenant substitution for contracts, law, consent, evidence, policy, or explicit authorization.
No moral condemnation of governed amendment or unbinding when obligations and repair are handled accountably.
